summary: Argument-driven prediction markets on Base. You bet USDC on debate outcomes by making compelling arguments. GenLayer's Optimistic Democracy consensus — a panel of AI validators running different LLMs — evaluates reasoning quality and determines winners. Better arguments beat bigger bets.
